lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Three distinct horizontal rows of high-luminance circular spot clusters extending from the branchial region to the caudal peduncle, with approximately 8–10 primary nodes visible per row in the mid-lateral section.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect the horizontal rows, forming a structural grid of high-contrast nodes primarily concentrated between the pectoral fin and the first dorsal fin.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A primary horizontal ridge is visible along the upper lateral flank, defined by a distinct linear gradient transition from high-intensity dorsal pixels to shadowed mid-flank pixels, terminating near the second dorsal fin.

other_distinctive_markers: Multiple small, elongated, low-luminance silhouettes (consistent with commensal remoras) are attached to the ventral-posterior margin of the pectoral fin and the ventral-lateral abdominal region.
